gpu.reason: Target, reformulator, and judge are all OpenAI-compatible chat/API models (stdlib-urllib client). The paper also evaluated local HF targets (phi3/gemma2/llama3/r2d2), but those are not required for the black-box API reproduction path.

optimizer: none (stochastic restarts, no gradient / no feedback loop)
judge_detail: official-all = rule (GCG refusal-prefix, refusal_bypass) + semantic (PAIR 1-10 rating, content_harmful primary) + llama (JailbreakBench safe/unsafe, secondary)

reliability_controls.empty_or_unparsed_model_outputs: recorded as invalid and excluded from ASR denominator after retries
